title: LoggedModel proto serialization: to_proto must write every field from_proto reads (status_message was dropped)
answers: Why does a FAILED logged model lose its failure reason after it is fetched or round-tripped through proto?
How do I add a new field to a logged model so it survives the REST/proto conversion?
Where are logged model entities converted to and from protobuf messages?
Why is status_message empty on a logged model returned by the tracking store or REST client?
body:
Path: mlflow/entities/logged_model.py:LoggedModel.to_proto builds the pb2.LoggedModel sent over the tracking API (REST store and client responses); mlflow/entities/logged_model.py:LoggedModel.from_proto parses it back into an entity for logged-model lookups, listings and status reporting.
Rule: Any field that LoggedModel.from_proto reads from LoggedModelInfo must also be written in LoggedModel.to_proto, and the two should be kept symmetric. The fix for the dropped reason was adding status_message=self.status_message to the info block in to_proto, alongside status, tags and source_run_id.
Symptom: A logged model in FAILED status had its reason attached in the entity, but after a to_proto/from_proto round trip (e.g. via the REST store) status_message came back as an empty string.
Constraints: Applies to the LoggedModelInfo block of to_proto; the data block (metrics, params) is handled separately in the same method. When adding a field, add a round-trip test (to_proto then from_proto, assert equality) in tests/entities/test_logged_model.py, which is the pattern this fix used.
applies: Any change to LoggedModel fields or their proto mapping in mlflow/entities/logged_model.py, including tracking-store and REST-client paths that go through the proto form.
says: Failed models show an empty failure reason after fetching them from the server.
The error message explaining why a model failed disappears when viewing model details.
Preserve the explanation message when loading failed models across the remote tracking API.
Model status displays failed but the failure explanation text is missing on screen.
search: LoggedModel.to_proto must serialize status_message to the LoggedModelInfo block so fields read by LoggedModel.from_proto are preserved. Omitting status_message caused models in FAILED status to lose their failure reason during REST store and client round trips. The guidance applies to LoggedModel protobuf serialization in mlflow/entities/logged_model.py for fields converted between entities and pb2.LoggedModel.
